core_obligations: Apply Lemma unramified-etale-local; assume U affine so X_U separated; V_ij -> X_U closed by Morphisms, Lemma image-proper-scheme-closed.
Shrink U so distinct V_ij, V_i'j' are disjoint; the union of the V_ij is clopen in X_U; its complement W satisfies W_u has no point over any x_i.
If the fibre of X -> S over s is exactly {x_1,...,x_n}, then W_u is empty.
proof_roadmap: Apply the base lemma; make U affine; use closedness of the V_ij in X_U to empty the pairwise intersections after shrinking; take the clopen complement W; specialize to the one-point-fibre situation.
